text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey!!
This is crazy serious, total major incident!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...I scored in the double digits on the test, you know...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Look at me, giving it my all!
This totally calls for a reward~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swept along by Tosen Jordan's momentum,
we visited the amusement park for some rest
and a well-deserved reward.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What should we ride? How about a thrill ride?!
What if my fake lashes fly off, though?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Or maybe popcorn!? It screams amusement park vibes!"

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Tch, look at 'em getting all hyped over something like this.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what?!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Must be nice, being able to fool around in a place like this.
I'm not having any fun here at all.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Are you really satisfied with this, big sis?
With this kind of child's play!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!?
Child's playyy!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Y-You really went and said it, huh!? You'd better prepare yourself!?
Just try and come over here!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, how was the Viking ship ride?
Talk about a total thrill, right?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: All it does is sway. The scenery doesn't even change.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wh-Why, you...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Spinning the teacups at full throttle... how about it...?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: I-I just started feeling sick, that's all...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Totally... Let's move on to the next one, the next...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
See, this amusement park's fun too, right?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph...! Umaland is obviously way better!
It's way more popular, too!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
I mean, are you really fine with this?!
Why the hell are you okay with something like this?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Look, it ain't about whether
it's good or bad.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I earned my victories fair and square,
so I feel on top of the world no matter where I am."

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: ...What do you mean, 'seize' it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"A reward for working hard?
That makes it extra special!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Here, why don't you try winning one too?
If you beat me in rock-paper-scissors, you get free ice cream.
Paid for by Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
It's whatever...
I can buy ice cream like that anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Just go with it!
Here we go—rock, paper, scissors!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Pon!
And there, I win~

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!?
You totally threw that late!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nu-uh~. I'm not cheating~.
What, wanna go again?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: ...I wouldn't mind doing it, but still...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This game of rock-paper-scissors continued until the boy finally won...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: How's that?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: ...Delicious.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Riiight~? That's the taste of victory.
It's delicious. Like, ya know...
'cause it's something I earned myself.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Quit your whinin' and just do your best for now.
And make sure to have fun!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm.
Well, I'll keep that in mind!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*, what a cheeky brat.
choice_data_list: You were a good big sister.
My test score isn't really something I can brag about...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah? I've got a younger sister.
Though she's more obedient. Guess that makes me a pro big sis?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Well, babysitting's over!
Time to have some fun from here on out!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Tosen Jordan had a complete blast
at the amusement park, showing off
a carefree, radiant smile.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's that supposed to mean!
Keep your nose out of it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously, it's not like it's a lie that I worked hard.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I won't let 'em mock me next time. I'm seriously gonna get my grades up! Just you watch!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whatever her reason was,
you couldn't help but smile at her ability
to give it her honest best...
